text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia sets up four telecommunication agencies as part of the government's modernization programme aimed at improving services to subscribers.
- Tunisia is going to achieve good performance in tourism in the long-term if it diversifies leisure-time activities.
- Tunisian export volume trebled during the last decade, and reached 5.4 billion dinars in 1996.
